content.rendered: Etivaz is made only during the summer months in remote mountain chalets, every wheel of L’Etivaz AOP is crafted over traditional wood-fired copper vats using milk from cows grazing on wildflower-filled Alpine meadows. The cheese is beautifully complex with fruity, floral notes along with a delicate hint of smoke.

excerpt.rendered: Etivaz is made only during the summer months in remote mountain chalets, every wheel of L’Etivaz AOP is crafted over […]

content.rendered:
Sicilia Fredda export authentic Sicilian foods worldwide, offering award-winning olive oils, artisanal pasta, cheeses and other Mediterranean delicacies.

Partnering with select producers, they bring genuine Southern Italian flavours to homes and businesses, celebrating Sicily’s heritage and culinary excellence in every product.

excerpt.rendered: Authentic Sicilian foods, olive oils, delicacies.

content.rendered:
Nut Farms are Kent-based producers of premium British nuts and oils, known for roasted cobnuts, English walnuts, nut butters and cold-pressed oils.

Committed to provenance and sustainability, they deliver authentic, flavourful nuts and nut products to markets, online customers, and food businesses, showcasing the best of British-grown produce.

excerpt.rendered: Premium British nuts, oils, sustainable produce.

content.rendered:
Fingal’s Bakery are artisan bakers in Greenwich, London, creating naturally leavened sourdough, rye breads, pastries and sweet treats using traditional methods. Their range includes seeded sourdough, ciabatta, pain au chocolat, almond croissants and cinnamon buns all baked fresh daily.

Craftsmanship and quality are at the heart of their bakery, with slow fermentation and stone deck ovens delivering exceptional flavour. They supply cafés, restaurants and markets, and invite visitors to enjoy their award‑worthy bakes in their café or at home.

excerpt.rendered: Artisan sourdough, pastries, fresh daily bakes.

content.rendered:
Curd & Cure are the South East’s leading independent artisan food and drink distributor, supplying some of the UK’s finest speciality producers since 1988. Based in Kent, they work closely with a trusted network of small and large producers to source and deliver outstanding quality products.

With over 1,400 artisan deli, farm shop and foodservice lines available for next-day national delivery, and a flexible pallet consolidation service for Europe, Curd & Cure are a key link between great producers and great food businesses.

They are proud to be the exclusive UK stockist of the newly crowned 2025 World Champion Cheese, Le Gruyère AOP, and are delighted to showcase this exceptional cheese at the market.

excerpt.rendered: Leading independent distributor of artisan food and drink.

content.rendered:
Feltham’s Farm are organic cheesemakers from the Blackmore Vale in South Somerset, best known for Renegade Monk, their multi award-winning ale-washed cheese made with local organic cow’s milk. Their range also includes Rebel Nun, Gert Lush, La Fresca Margarita and Lucky Marcel – all Great Taste Award winners, with Lucky Marcel taking Super Gold at the World Cheese Awards 2024.

Sustainability sits at the heart of the farm, powered by solar energy, ground source heat pumps and rare breed pigs that recycle whey, alongside tree planting and organic farming practices certified by the Soil Association. Founders of the Organic Cheesemakers’ Network, Feltham’s Farm champion organic principles in British cheese.

They regularly trade at London farmers’ markets and are delighted to share their cheeses with new customers – including their light, fresh La Fresca Margarita, a standout organic queso fresco.

excerpt.rendered: Award-winning organic cheesemakers rooted in sustainability.

content.rendered: Representing some of the finest cheeses from select dairies across Europe, European Fine Cheese showcases the lesser-known gems of the artisan cheese world. Working with trusted partners around the world, they bring delicious and characterful cheeses to discerning customers, highlighting the craft, heritage and diversity of Europe’s cheesemaking traditions in every wheel, wedge and bite.

excerpt.rendered: Alfie brings cheeses like Potz Blitz and Perle des Apes from small producers in Switzerland and Holland.

content.rendered: Using live edge timber and occasionally blending in epoxy resin, Sarah crafts unique home decor and gifting pieces that highlight the wood’s natural grain, knots, and organic voids. Ready to ship offerings span from charcuterie boards, coaster sets, and egg holders to candle holders and sculptural side and coffee tables, each infused with warmth and artisan flair. For those seeking something personal, bespoke commissions are warmly welcomed to bring your vision to life.

excerpt.rendered: Crafted by hand using live edge timber, Sawn by Sarah creates unique homewares and gifts full of natural beauty.

content.rendered: ​The Pretty Cheese Company is a UK artisan producer specialising in hand-marinated cheeses infused with fresh herbs, edible flowers, and aromatic oils, creating visually stunning and flavourful cheeses that celebrate seasonal ingredients and traditional craftsmanship.

excerpt.rendered: ​The Pretty Cheese Company is a UK artisan producer specialising in hand-marinated cheeses infused with fresh herbs, edible flowers, and […]

content.rendered: White Lake’s home is at Bagborough Farm, just near to the Glastonbury Festival site in Somerset. Roger Longman, the 3rd generation owner makes cheese from his own own beloved herd of, primarily, French Alpine goats. A local Guernsey herd provide the cow’s milk, and the sheep’s milk comes from another well trusted farm. The result is minimal food miles, support from the community, and – of course – truly exceptional cheese.

excerpt.rendered: Somerset dairy specialising in cheeses made from goats and sheep milk with some Jersey cows milk cheese too. Don’t miss their Taste 3 star award-winning Driftwood and Tor.

content.rendered: Using traditional smoking methods and high-quality ingredients, their charcuterie and smoked cheese are rich in flavour and ideal for cheese boards or antipasti.

excerpt.rendered: Handmade smoked meats and cheese.

content.rendered: The Wild Room specialises in foraged items, offering a unique and ever-changing selection of wild foods that make excellent accompaniments to cheese boards and charcuterie platters. From earthy wild mushrooms to tart seasonal berries and aromatic herbs, they provide ingredients that elevate the tasting experience of artisan cheese.

excerpt.rendered: The finest wild and exotic mushrooms, foraged produce, seaweeds, medicinal mushroom tinctures and truffles.

content.rendered: Specialist tomato producer from the Isle of Wight, growing up to 200 varieties they make an excellent addition to cheese boards or as ingredients in recipes with cheese.

excerpt.rendered: Specialist tomato producer from the Isle of Wight, growing up to 200 varieties.

content.rendered: Sophie’s Delight offers plant-based cheese alternatives made with traditional methods, catering to vegans and those seeking dairy-free options. Their innovative approach ensures the taste and texture of artisanal cheeses.

excerpt.rendered: Artisan small-batch vegan cheezes made with natural ingredients – the tasty and nutritious alternative to dairy.

content.rendered: Todd and Maugan Trethowan hand make the multi-award-winning Pitchfork Cheddar and Gorwydd Caerphilly using raw milk and traditional methods in North Somerset.

excerpt.rendered: Pitchfork Cheddar and Gorwydd Caerphilly.

content.rendered: Raw, unprocessed honey sourced from sustainably managed hives in Portugal. A great accompaniment for cheeses, particularly soft and tangy varieties like goat cheese or Brie. The range includes rosemary, wild lavender, oak, heather and multi floral honeys.

excerpt.rendered: Organic Portuguese honey.

content.rendered: A fabulous array of feta, olives, saucisson, nuts and antipasti.

excerpt.rendered: Feta, saucisson, nuts, antipasti and olives.

content.rendered: Nut Knowle Farm produces an exceptional range of artisan goat cheeses, all handcrafted in the heart of East Sussex from a single herd.

excerpt.rendered: 14 varieties of Sussex handmade goat’s cheese from a single herd.

content.rendered: Located in Wendover, No. 2 Pound Street is a fabulous cheesemonger who bring 3 different British Artisan cheeses with great stories to every market.

excerpt.rendered: Fabulous cheesemonger and Cheese Academy tutor brings 3 different cheeses with great stories to every market.

content.rendered: Love Fermented specialises in handcrafted kimchi and fermented foods, made using traditional fermentation methods. Their products are packed with flavour and probiotics, offering a vibrant and tangy accompaniment to cheese.

excerpt.rendered: Local kimchis and pickles – home made and unpasteurised.

content.rendered: London Smoke and Cure specialises in producing artisanal charcuterie, smoked fish, and cured meats, all crafted with care in small batches in London. Each month they bring a fine selection of different cheeses alongside a selection of their smoked products.

excerpt.rendered: Award-winning charcuterie, cheese and cold-smoked salmon.

content.rendered: Unbelievably good authentic Basque cheesecake made in London using a family recipe and well-deserved winners of a three star Great Taste Award.

excerpt.rendered: Authentic Basque cheesecake made in London by Lucia using a family recipe.

content.rendered: Local, West London mozzarella and burrata as seen on Stanley Tucci’s ‘Taste of Italy’ series plus pasta and a selection of cheese from Italy and the UK.

excerpt.rendered: Local, West London mozzarella and burrata as seen on Stanley Tucci’s ‘Taste of Italy’ series.

content.rendered: Stef’s Kitchen, based in Kentish Town, creates a delightful array of homemade jams and preserves, designed to complement cheese boards or add a burst of flavour to everyday meals. Using seasonal fruits and traditional techniques, Stef’s products offer an authentic, artisanal touch. Their jams are known for their balance of sweetness and acidity, making them a perfect pairing for cheeses and charcuterie.

excerpt.rendered: Jams, preserves & chutneys.

content.rendered: A variety of unique, flavoured cheddar cheeses that combine the bold taste of jalopenos with churrasco, peri peri, chipotle or lime each creating a distinctive flavour experience.

excerpt.rendered: Small-batch creamy cheddar with a kick – handcrafted with flavoursome halopeños inside.

content.rendered: The best sizzling grilled cheese sandwiches made with artisan sourdough bread to order using fresh, high-quality cheeses and accompaniments.

excerpt.rendered: Artisan sourdough cheese sandwiches and toasties.

content.rendered: The French Comté specialises in Comté cheese, and they bring 4 different ages each month as well as huge array of French cheese and Mont d’Or when it is in season plus whole salamis and terrines.

excerpt.rendered: Specialising in Alpine cheeses and artisan French cheese and Mont d’Or when in season.

content.rendered: Finer Things Deli are Spanish cheese and jamon specialists. Each month they bring a jamon leg so they can cut to order as well as a gorgeous selection of artisanal Spanish cheeses, and the accompaniments to tie everything together – olives, breadsticks and membrillo.

excerpt.rendered: Spanish cheeses and charcuterie.

content.rendered: Emilia (trading under the name Bianca & Mora) focus on high-quality cheeses and charcuterie sourced directly from Italy. Their famous Red Cow Parmigiano Reggiano is always a feature at the market. Also available each month are a selection of other Italian cheese including a Pecorino Romano and charcuterie.

excerpt.rendered: Famous Red Cow 32 month aged Parmesan and Italian charcuterie.

content.rendered: A unique approach to cheese maturation, they infuse the rinds of different Italian cheeses with wine, grape must, beer or gin to enhance the flavours and textures.

excerpt.rendered: Wine, grape and eau de vie-steeped Italian cheeses.

content.rendered: Dispensamor offers an intriguing combination of cheese and pasta. Their pasta selections are similarly made with care, using only high-quality ingredients to create gourmet experiences for cheese lovers and pasta afficionados alike.

excerpt.rendered: Variety of cheeses from Italy and France, plus handmade pasta.

content.rendered: Known for their exceptional range of jams, chutneys and marmalades. The sweet and tangy flavours pair wonderfully with cheese.

excerpt.rendered: Chutney, jelly and jam handmade in Wiltshire.

content.rendered: Founded by a Dutch family, based in Looe in Cornwall. Giel Spierings crafts traditional Dutch Gouda with a Cornish twist. Using milk from their own cows, they focus on creating high-quality cheeses with diverse flavour profiles from maturation or adding herbs and spices.

excerpt.rendered: Hand-produced Cornish Gouda cheese made using traditional Dutch techniques.

content.rendered: Nestled in the heart of Cornwall, The Cornish Cheese Co. produces award-winning Cornish Blue cheese. They prioritise quality and use milk from local herds for a creamy and tangy flavour profile.

excerpt.rendered: Makers of award-winning cheeses, including Cornish Blue, Cornish Nanny and Cornish Brie.

content.rendered: Collana Verde makes organic olive oil from 4 different varieties of olives grown in Campania.

excerpt.rendered: Organic producers of extra virgin olive oil.

content.rendered: Small artisan cheesemaker from Farnham using pasteurised milk from Pierrepoint Farm. The range includes Tilston Blue; Millie, a cheese similar to Caerphilly; Weywood, a soft cheese with a cider washed rind and Tommie which is a seasonal Alpine style cheese.

excerpt.rendered: Small batch artisan cheese from a single herd near Farnham.

content.rendered: Run by the fabulous Faye who curates and ages some of the finest artisanal cheeses from across the UK and beyond. She will always have Baron Bigod, White Lake cheeses, plus a selection from fantastic Sussex, including Golden Cross and Mayfield.

excerpt.rendered: English cheeses including Pevensey Blue, Baron Bigod, Mayfield, White Lake goats.

content.rendered: Beans World specialise in premium balsamic vinegars and flavoured vinegars which pair beautifully with cheese. Their balsamics come in a variety of aged options, from the everyday to the exceptional, and each is crafted to elevate flavours in any culinary setting.

excerpt.rendered: Cold pressed rapeseed oil and specialist Italian vinegars.

content.rendered: Using pasteurised milk from their own herd at Park Farm near Bath the family make a variety of cheeses including Bath Soft, a soft and yielding white bloomy rind cheese; Wyfe of Bath a semi-hard cheese with a rich, creamy interior and a slightly nutty taste; and Bath Blue, a creamy blue cheese that has also been a World Cheese Awards champion too.

excerpt.rendered: Award-winning organic cheese made by hand near Bath at Park Farm, Kelston, with milk from their own cows.

content.rendered: L’Amuse Bouche specialises in authentic French crêpes and galettes (gluten-free), using traditional recipes and carefully sourced ingredients, their signature dishes include The Goaty (goat’s cheese, chutney, spinach, and tomatoes) and The Raclette (raclette cheese, ham, mushrooms, and mustard sauce).

excerpt.rendered: London-based street food business specialising in gluten-free crêpes & galettes.
